craft_notes: Sthāyin: Courage of refuge (utsāha). End-dash→comma (resetting softens onto wondering). Rejected: 'gape' for 'boggles' — L3 kept. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Scene by scene thou resettest the painted show,
at that thy craft, Lord, what bright mind but boggles?
l4.sanskrit_cite: muhur muhur jagaccitrasy-ānyānyāṃ sthitim ūhitum śaktir yā te tayā nātha ko manasvī na vismitaḥ

reads_against.argmap: Again and again, to arrange each next state of the world-picture. → Your ever-arranging power amazes every mindful one.
c1_essence: Name alone perfects to release; ever-reset painted world amazes the keen.

l2.plain_english: Stage after stage you reset the painted world, ever and again — lord, at that craft of yours, what keen heart is not stunned?
